email.description: The email address of the user, preferrably this should be set by providing an authorization header, using this will mark the message as anonymous

landscapeId.description: The landscape that the message is regarding, only available when the user is authenticated

organizationId.description: The organization that the message is regarding, only available when the user is authenticated

url.description: The url of the page that was viewed when the message is created

userId.description: The user that created the message if the request was authenticated
